name: SSH & Remote Server
description: ⟦ctv⟧Control a machine you cannot touch. Every failure in this track was reproduced on a real sshd and every log line is copied from a real terminal — including the four different reasons SSH refuses you while showing the exact same message.

modules.name: What SSH Actually Is
modules.description: A process listening on port 22 that turns bytes into a shell. The handshake read line by line from a real ssh -vvv.

modules.name: Public Key Authentication
modules.description: Why publishing your .pub is safe, why the private key never moves, and what authorized_keys really is.

modules.name: Four Ways SSH Says No
modules.description: Wrong network, wrong file mode, wrong SELinux label, wrong sshd config — one symptom, four cures.

modules.name: The SSH Config File
modules.description: Aliases, IdentityFile, ServerAliveInterval, ProxyJump — turning a 90-character command into three letters.

modules.name: No TTY: Why sudo Dies Over SSH
modules.description: ssh host 'cmd' gives you no terminal. What that breaks, and how to write scripts that never need sudo.

modules.name: Moving Files: scp and rsync
modules.description: scp, rsync, deletion semantics, and why deploy.sh rsyncs the working tree instead of a commit.

modules.name: Tunnels and Port Forwarding
modules.description: Forward and reverse tunnels, and how a machine behind NAT reaches the world by dialling out first.

modules.name: Keeping Sessions Alive
modules.description: tmux, nohup and systemd units — three answers to 'my build died when the laptop slept'.

modules.name: Hardening the Server
modules.description: Turning off password login, fail2ban, port choice, and why disabling the sudo password is the wrong trade.
